module: Flowgraph node 'Increaser' (repeat_instant category). Keeps the maximum of the input value in memory: if 'value' exceeds the internal value, the latter is replaced. 'clear' resets to data.resetValue (0). Outputs: flow, impulse 'changed', 'result'.
notes: pinOut.changed is only reset to false if 'value' is not nil.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Applies clear, updates the maximum, writes result; flow follows the flow input.
